name: bedrock-meter
description: Token and USD meter for pay-per-token Amazon Bedrock sessions: a band above the prompt with cost, context, cache and today's total, priced at AWS's own on-demand rates

regionalPremiumPct.title: Regional premium (%)
regionalPremiumPct.description: Fallback surcharge for a regional or geo (us., eu., apac.) request on a model the price table lists with global prices only. Models AWS lists both ways are priced at AWS's own regional rates, so this rarely applies. Set 0 to turn it off.

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Toast once when the session's estimated cost passes this amount. 0 turns it off.

openPane.title: Open pane at start
openPane.description: Open the breakdown pane when a session starts (it waits for a wide enough terminal). /bedrock-cost opens it anytime.
